pages.text: $(thing)Simply Swords$() unique weapons are the best weapons in the pack. They are $(bold)boss-drop-only$() — not craftable, not tradeable, not found in chests. Each is matched to a specific boss thematically.$(br2)$(bold)42 unique weapons$() exist across all 4 tiers. Drop chances range from 8% (rarest) to 25% (Ender Dragon's $(item)Waking Lichblade$()). On average, expect 6–8 kills to guarantee a drop.

pages.text: $(li)Ender Dragon: $(item)Waking Lichblade$() (25%)$(li)Ultimate Bosses: $(item)Mjolnir$(), $(item)Storm's Edge$()$(li)Deep Aether: $(item)Flamewind$()$(br2)$(bold)Build note:$() Unique weapons do not have an enchanting penalty — they can be enchanted normally via $(thing)Apotheosis$().
